_comment: Non-secret environment profiles for THIS repository only.
The thing worth being explicit about here is the DATABASE. MobileAPI read-modify-writes
productdetails, productscrapdetails and stockhistories, the same collections AdminAPI and
eBayAPI write. Starting it against the wrong one is not visible from the outside and is
not undone by stopping the process.
autocheckerpartsclone is the LIVE database and autocheckerpartsclonenew is STAGING.
The names read the other way round to most people's expectation, which is exactly why
they are declared below and checked rather than remembered.
Credentials are never stored here. MONGO_URI belongs in this repository's .env (local)
or in the deployment's shared/.env (staging, production); the profile only says which
database that URI is REQUIRED to name, and refuses to start if it names another.

classify._note: scrapernew.autochecker.com is the AWS scraper-v2 box (nginx/TLS in front of :3050). 54.153.64.15 is the older :3000 scraper that the React staging build still points at. A staging profile naming a production host is refused.

autocheckerpartsclonenew.note: staging database (hosted on the production cluster)

local.description: MobileAPI on this machine, against the staging database and a scraper-v2 running locally.

staging.description: MobileAPI as the staging deployment runs it.
staging._note: SCRAPER_URL is deliberately not set here. There is no confirmed staging host for scraper-v2 yet, and defaulting it to the production scraper would send staging traffic at the live one. Set it in the deployment's shared/.env; the production host is refused by the check above.

production.description: MobileAPI as the production deployment runs it: the LIVE database and the AWS scraper-v2.
